# Desart Home Interiors

> Desart Home Interiors (Desart Builders Pvt Ltd) is an interior design and build firm based in Marthandam, Kanyakumari district, Tamil Nadu, India, with 12+ years of experience. It designs, manufactures in its own factory, and installs complete home interiors, modular kitchens, wardrobes, TV units and false ceilings for homes in Marthandam, Nagercoil and Trivandrum (Thiruvananthapuram). Clients rate it 4.9 out of 5 on Google.

Key facts:

- Studio and factory: Marthandam, Kanyakumari district, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 88070 40606
- Email: hello@desart.in
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Areas served: Marthandam, Nagercoil, Kuzhithurai, Thuckalay, Colachel, Kaliyakkavilai, Eraniel and the rest of Kanyakumari district, plus Trivandrum (Thiruvananthapuram), Kerala
- Services: full home (turnkey) interiors, modular kitchens, wardrobes and storage, living room and TV units, false ceiling and lighting, 3D design and 360-degree VR walkthroughs
- Process: free consultation, design, factory production, on-site execution, handover
- Timeline: about 45 days for a full home after design sign-off; 3 to 4 weeks for a single kitchen or wardrobe set
- Materials: BWP (boiling-water-proof) plywood, sealed edge-banding and branded soft-close hardware suited to coastal humidity
- Warranty: lifetime warranty on units made in Desart's own factory; manufacturer's warranty on bought-out hardware and appliances
- Payments: stage-linked milestones, so clients pay for work that is complete
